title: 第25章 萧凡变相的讨礼物第26章 下令清理王府中的探子
slug: 开局六连抽创建万古帝朝
content_zh:
看到自己的小侍女灵玉在艰难抵御，
床上躺着的萧凡装作受不住地连连咳嗽了两声，“皇叔！皇叔！”
大宗正萧玉虎这才如梦初醒，
急忙收敛了那排山倒海般的强横气势。
看到自己把侄子的卧室搞得一塌糊涂，顿时，尴尬得无地自容！
萧凡则继续装可怜，“唉！想必是有人嫉妒侄子太过出类拔萃，挡住了他们的青云之路。
而且侄子势单力薄，背后没有任何背景或者势力撑腰。
说着说着，眼泪又像断了线的珠子一样吧嗒吧嗒地掉落下来。
真是闻者伤心，见者落泪！”
这一情况使得大宗正萧玉虎那原本紧绷着的心弦稍稍松弛了下来。
要知道，身为大宗正的萧玉虎，向来都是个五大三粗、性格豪放之人，
对于如何去安抚他人这种细腻之事，实在是不甚擅长。
当他听闻侄子萧凡亲口说出自身并无任何背景或是势力撑腰时，
这位萧氏皇族的大宗正心中顿时涌起一股不满与不悦之情。
他皱起眉头，瞪大双眼，对着躺在床上脸色苍白的萧凡扯着嗓子大声吼道：
“好侄子！咱们萧氏皇族可不就是你最为坚强且有力的后盾嘛！
你皇叔我身为这大宗正，
定会全力以赴将那胆敢对你下毒的恶徒捉拿归案，并依法严惩，
定要替你出了这口恶气，报此深仇！”
说完这话后，

萧玉虎脸上的神情瞬间来了个一百八十度大转弯，转而换上一副狡黠的笑容，
继续说道：“再者说了，你皇叔我！还有你的父皇，早就已经为你和那镇国公府的嫡女李秀宁定下了亲事。
只要等到好侄子你风风光光地成为镇国公家的乘龙快婿之后，
放眼这整个朝堂之上，
又有谁还敢大放厥词，说你缺乏势力的支持？
到那时，
看那些曾经小瞧过你的家伙们，还不得一个个都乖乖闭上嘴巴，对你敬畏有加！”
接着他面色一沉，鼻中发出一声重重的冷哼，
随后缓缓开口说道：“哼，既然有些人不想让好侄子你与那镇国公府的嫡女李秀宁成就这门亲事，
老夫我偏就要将此事促成不可！
待老夫回去之后，
定要立刻前往宫中面见陛下，
向他讨要一道为好侄子你和镇国公府嫡女李秀宁赐婚的圣旨。”
此时，躺在床上的萧凡将皇叔萧玉虎所说之话一字一句听入耳中，
content_en:
Seeing his little maid Lingyu struggling to resist,
Xiao Fan, who was lying on the bed, pretended to be unable to bear it and coughed twice, "Uncle Emperor! Uncle Emperor!"
Da Zongzheng Xiao Yuhu just woke up from a dream,
He hurriedly restrained his overwhelming tyrannical momentum.
When I saw that I had made a mess in my nephew's bedroom, I was instantly embarrassed!
Xiao Fan continued to pretend to be pitiful, "Oh! Someone must be jealous that his nephew is too outstanding and blocks their path to success.
Moreover, the nephew is weak and has no background or power behind him.
As he spoke, tears fell again like broken beads.
It really makes those who hear it sad and those who see it cry! "
This situation made Da Zongzheng Xiao Yuhu's originally tense heartstrings relax a little.
You must know that Xiao Yuhu, a great Zongzheng, has always been a rough and bold person with a bold personality.
I'm really not very good at such delicate things as how to appease others.
When he heard his nephew Xiao Fan personally say that he had no background or power to support him,
A feeling of dissatisfaction and displeasure suddenly surged in the heart of the Xiao royal family's great master.
He frowned, widened his eyes, and shouted at the top of his lungs at Xiao Fan, who was lying on the bed with a pale face:
"Good nephew! Our Xiao royal family is your strongest and most powerful support!
Your uncle and I, as the great sect leader,
We will go all out to catch the villain who dared to poison you and punish them severely in accordance with the law.
I must avenge you for this bad breath! "
After saying this,
The expression on Xiao Yuhu's face instantly turned 180 degrees, and turned into a sly smile.
He continued: "Besides, your imperial uncle, I, and your father have already arranged a marriage for you and Li Xiuning, the legitimate daughter of the Zhenguo Palace.
As long as you, my good nephew, become the proud son-in-law of the Zhenguo government,
Looking at the entire court,
Who dares to speak out loudly and say that you lack the support of forces?
Until then,
Look at those guys who once looked down on you, but they all shut up obediently and are in awe of you! "
Then his expression darkened, and he let out a heavy snort from his nose,
Then he slowly said: "Huh, since some people don't want your good nephew to get married with Li Xiuning, the legitimate daughter of the Duke of Zhenguo Mansion,
I must make this happen!
After I get back,
I must go to the palace immediately to meet His Majesty.
Ask him for an imperial edict granting a marriage between you, your good nephew, and Li Xiuning, the legitimate daughter of the Duke of Zhenguo. "
At this time, Xiao Fan, who was lying on the bed, listened to what the emperor's uncle Xiao Yuhu said word by word.
